text_block_list.text: I've got no memory of that whatsoever~!

Startled by the loud voice, Kitasan Black 
and I rushed over, only to find Gold Ship 
looking troubled.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It's goooone, my memories of yesterday! I 
checked inside my bag, I checked inside 
tree hollows, but I still can't find 'em 
anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
P-Please calm down! Is there anything I 
can do to help?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniffle*, I must have dropped my 
precious memories somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Please~! Help me find my memory~! At this 
rate, someone else is gonna pick it up~!
choice_data_list:
(Can memories just be... lying on the 
ground...?)

(Can memories really be dropped on the 
ground like that...?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll help you out, so let's 
find Golshi-san's memories together!

And so, the three of them ended up touring 
the academy, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I feel it! It's calling to me! The 
Rheingold must definitely be around here 
somewhere, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's around here, right! All right, I'll 
search thoroughly to see if it fell or got 
buried somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...No, there are so many weeds it's hard 
to search. Shall we do some weeding while 
we're at it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, a memory! Located!! But this is 
from when I fought the Martians last week! 
In other words, this isn't the one I'm 
looking for...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Indeed I did. It was quite a delightful 
time♪ Alright, on to the next one, let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shhhhh, quiet! So we don't get noticed, we 
gotta search carefully for that bastard 
memory...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, quietly... Ah, I'll tidy up the 
books that look like they're about to 
collapse.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Close! But that's tomorrow's memory! 
Wait, what? Golshi-sama becomes 
president?!"
choice_data_list:
(Becoming president is taking it way too 
far...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~! It looked dangerous 
around our feet, so I put away the 
equipment left lying around! Now, let's 
keep searching for those memories!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's proving quite difficult to 
find.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm more than ready to keep helping 
out!

Kitasan Black hasn't been discouraged, but 
is it really okay to keep stringing her 
along on such shady schemes?
choice_data_list: Do you still believe you have amnesia?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whether you believe me or not doesn't 
matter! I just want to help Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't just turn a blind eye to someone 
in trouble. That's why I want to see this 
through to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Kitasan... But man, I've already 
checked every place I could think of...
choice_data_list:
Don't give up, let's do another lap around 
the school!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's fine... I'm done being trapped 
by the past. What matters most is 
definitely the time we're spending right 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, leaving you without your memories 
makes me worried... I can still help you 
out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. It killed plenty of time—wait, 
no. I realized something way more 
important!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The present over the past! Since you guys 
taught me that, I'm gonna give you 
something good!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Rub some salt into it and shove it under 
your pillow! Sweet dreams!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Is that some kind of good luck charm?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Golshi-san looked like she had a 
load taken off her mind, didn't she! I'm 
so glad!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um... "I did it all"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so it seems. I truly appreciate all 
your painstaking efforts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for eavesdropping. Actually, I 
heard someone went above and beyond for 
the academy, so I came to express my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Weeding, tidying the library, putting away 
left-out live concert equipment. These 
were all requests submitted to the 
suggestion box by troubled students.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I was just searching for my own things 
anyway, so I'm glad I could help!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To achieve so much purely in passing fills 
me with immense admiration. Calling this 
'virtue rewarded' is far too modest, but 
please, allow me to repay your deed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, delicious cookies! I want to share 
some of these with Golshi-san later!

Always ready to lend a helping hand. It 
was a day that truly showed just how 
generous and open-hearted Kitasan Black 
is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right! If we call someone over, 
maybe—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Found you at last, Gold Ship-san! 
Yesterday, you—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on, McQueen. You're not 
seriously about to ask someone with 
amnesia what happened yesterday, are you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Amnesia? You?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying you've also forgotten 
singing a strange song in front of my room 
last night?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember, I swear~! I didn't do 
anything, I swear~!
choice_data_list: (I see, so that's what it was for!)
(I see, that's what this was all for!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Getting someone else involved 
yet again... Just so you know, I didn't 
come here to scold you, alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've had trouble falling asleep lately. So 
when you started singing in the middle of 
the night, I wondered what on earth I 
should do with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Listening to your song made me fall into a 
deep, sound sleep for some reason. 
Consider this... a small token of thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you do not remember, it cannot 
be helped. I shall take this back with me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What gives, what gives, Macquee~n!! If 
you're gonna give me something, I'll 
remember in a heartbeat!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, how mercenary of you!! ...I 
apologize, Kita-san, Trainer-san. Thank 
you for looking after her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They've gone, haven't they...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's a relief! Golshi-san did say 
she'd remember right away, after all. Now 
I can rest easy!

Kitasan Black beamed happily, having 
believed in Gold Ship until the very end.
